content: Nere mora bagu, Yesus dukote wogunga umei nomo bode, beele ngado wane.
Yesus no beele waha oruwa malalamudu lebordu bona, nomo disaipel benou lenigai,

“Tere isiya, Fati Itou no Israel Awa Nigainga Yafa Dewane, waha Ninatege Isagu ganga, fati waha heigon bona fati ngaanga jiridere. Ono gonga, nere Fai Nomo Idau honggoro fai owonege langa tafa tuwogunga, nauge abalakawou langa tofiye tuwodbode.”
Saini waha langa pris aroro bagu, Israel nebere mora bagu, pris anyakaro nomo unyi Kaiafas, nomo mata langa koto wane.
Onodu bode, nere Yesus yaawa tudu taidu bode, dukote wogunga umei nomo jala kuru bode beele ngado wane.
Onou wa nere lewane, “Ere dada waha bori nomo fati anyakaro langa ada onowoya. Gamaji nere fai-aita bagu uredu hounege mayonga oota jaimu woguga.”
Aita ete Yesus mora langa sanda feuwai.
Yesus no Betani matane Saimon nomo mata langa yafai, fai waha no amina kaba taura bagu.

Ono gainga, aita ete no megebu kuluma langa sanda hilobainga ete, nomo ejiyawou moni gai anyakaro, waha tedu bona Yesus bagu mayai. Onodu bona, saini Yesus no tewol langa yafa gainga, no sanda waha Yesus mora langa feuwai.
Ono wainga, nere disaipel waha uredu bode, huwanyanege inyabawai. Ono wainga nere lewane, “Taate bona sanda waha ewe heilena?
Ere sanda waha fai awa nagedenga ejiyawou wage, wa ere edo langa moni anyakaro tedu boya, nere fai dadanege uwau waha nigedege.”
Ono wanenga Yesus no nebere beele waha amina isai, onodu bona lenigai, “Tere taate boya aita beha ou tuya? No onowou hilobainga ono hiyaha.
Nere fai dadanege uwau waha, saini baingaro tere bagu yafodbode. Onou wa, ji nu tere bagu gai-gai ada yafon boni.
Aita no ji geefe gala langa sanda feuwai waha beha, no ji geefe gala matmat langa haiya bona ono waha.
Ji tere ngalenga letigini, nere oula oruwa langa goidu bode hilou beele beha malalamudu lewode langa, nere aita beha dada onowai waha fere lewodbode, ono bode nere no bode ninanege isodbode.”
Judas no Yesus mora bagu owonege langa nigei nomo beele baara tawai.
Saini waha langa nere disaipel 12 waha nebereha ete, nomo unyi Judas Iskariot, no pris aroro bagu goyai.
Onodu benou isoki nigai, “Ji Yesus tere owotege langa tigi boni wonga, tere taate dada hiyagu ganga?” Ono wainga, nere silwa moni 30 onou tuwane.
Ono wanenga Judas no Yesus nere owonege langa nigonbona jala kuruwou hugu warai.
Yesus nomo disaipel bagu da nyane.

Beret Yis Uwau Nomo Fati Anyakaro waha nomo fati amugou langa, nere disaipel Yesus bagu maidu bode letuwane, “Ere dada alanga haiyawei nomo gau hinina, ono wedenga, ne Itou no Israel Awa Nigainga Hilou Yafane waha nomo fati bona, ninate isei nomo da nyau ganga?”

Ono wanenga Yesus no fai ete bona ledu, lenigai, “Tere taon huwanya langa goidu, fai waha benou letuwagu, ‘Isisiwou fai lewaha, Yame saini amina jugu waha. Ji yame disaipel bagu name mata langa maidu Itou No Israel Awa Nigainga Hilou Yafane waha nomo da nyoboya.’ ”
Ono wainga disaipel nere Yesus lenigai onounga onodu bode, da haiya wane.
Ono wanenga esuwa Yesus no disaipel 12 bagu tewol langa yafane.
Nere da nyi bode yafa ganenga, no lewai, “Ji ngalenga letigini, tebereha ete no ji, honggoro fai owonege langa nigonbona.”
Ono wainga, disaipel nere beele waha isidu huwanyanege ou dewai, ono wainga nere etenga-etengadu benou isoki tuwou hugu warane, “Anyakaro, Ji boni leni yo?”
Ono wanenga no ege gidu benou lenigai, “Fai no ji honggoro fai owonege langa tafa hiyon bona wa, no tebereha ete ji ngare owo haaya langa tafaha waha.

Fai Nomo Idau no umonbona, Itou nomo buk lewai onounga, no edo umonbona. Onou wa, fai no Fai Nomo Idau honggoro fai owonege langa nigina waha, no augami bagu. Fai waha nomo anya ada bisi tuwage wa hilobainga.”
Ono wainga Judas, fai waha no Yesus nere honggoro fai owonege langa nigonbona, no Yesus benou isoki tuwai, “Isisiwou fai ne ji boni leni yo?” Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Ne leni onounga.”
Yesus no disaipel beret wain bagu nigai.
Nere da nyi bode yafa ganenga, Yesus no beret ete tedu bona, Itou hilobainga tudu bona kokorudu disaipel nigai. Ono bona lewai, “Tere elegedu nyagu. Beha ji yame geefe gala.”
Onodu no wain kap ete tedu bona, Itou hilobainga tudu nere nigi bona lewai, “Tere oruwanga kap beha langa nyagu.
Beha ji yame ganefe beele agili mala karuwou. Ji fai-aita bagu baingaro nebere une uulu nagei nomo boni feuni.
Ji tere letigini, Ji ege wain ada nyoni, goi saini ji tere bagu gaara wain eege yame Jijei nomo huuna langa yafou waha huwanya langa nyonboni.”
Onodu nere moone ete te-bode, taon awa tudu Oliv muju langa manane.
Yesus no lewai Pita no moge tuwonbona.

Onodu Yesus nomo disaipel lenigai, “Ooru beha langa, dada ji langa heige gonga uredu, tere oruwanga huwanyatege ngalengawou mebodu wonbona, taate bona, Itou nomo buk langa beele benou bagu, ‘Ji oofa nigou fai dukote wehenga sipsip kejiwe heige hara wodbode.’
Onou wa, ji ege gidu maidu tere amuge tigidu boni, Galili langa goyon boni.”
Ono wainga Pita no ege benou letuwai, “Buyona, nere ila dada ne langa heigonga uredu, nebere huwanyanege ngalengawou oruwa mebodu wonga, ne awa hinei mata wogunga wa, ji ne ada awa hinoni.”
Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Ji ne ngalenga lehinini, elebe ooru beha langa, saini teewe waregu uwa la, ne benou le ei wau ganga, ne ji boni alai uwa.”
Ono wainga Pita letuwai, “Ono urona, ji ne ngare ume boyare wonga wa edonga, ji benou ada lewoni, ji ne boni ada isini. Gai uwanga uwa.” Ono wainga nere disaipel oruwanga beele onounga lewane.
Yesus no Getsemani haga langa hauya wai.
Yesus no nomo disaipel bagu haumu ete Getsemani ide walanga goyane. Onodu no benou lenigai, “Tere bela yafa gadenga, ji mani wolanga hauya won boni.”
Onodu bona, no Pita wainga Sebedi idau gane nga nononga hanigedu bona manai. Ono bona no huwanya ou tuwai, onodu no gai inyaba isai.
Onodu bona no lenigai, “Ji huwanyafe ou dena, ji umoni juguni. Tere belanga ji ngate yafa boya oofawei nomo.”

Onodu, no menanga onou golodu goidu bona, mebodudu hogo oula tudu benou hauya wai, “Yame Jijei, Edo wonga wa, ne kap beha tedu ariri hayei nomo gau hina. Onou wa, ne yame gauwou adai oojowau. Uwa. Ne name gauwou wahanga oojowau.”
Onodu Yesus no disaipel ei bagu medu, nere agore jiri ganenga nerigai. Onodu no Pita benou isoki tuwai, “Adadu? Tere ji bagu awa etenga oofawei nomo edo uwa yo?
Tere oofadu hauya bonade yafagu. Gamaji wala-wala tigou mayonga mebodu wagu ganga. Ngalenga, huwanyatege no dada onowei nomo gau tuna, onou wa, getege gala no danga uwau.”
Onodu bona no ege mani nga wai, onodu benou hauyawai, “Yame Jijei, kap waha ji feiya hiyei nomo edo uwa, ji edo nyonboni wonga, ne name gauwou wahanga oojowau.”
Onodu bona, no ege gidu me nerigai wa nere jiri gane, taate bona, nere agenege ou wainga agore jiri wane.
Onodu bona no ege awa nigidu bona, mani hauya ei wai. No amugedu hauya wai onounga, ege hauya wai.
Iinga no disaipel bagu medu bona benou lenigai, “Tere agore jiri boya houwe tafaya yo? Isagu. Saini amina wai jugu waha nere elebe Fai Nomo Idau une fai owonege langa tafa tuwodbode.
Tere jayadenga goyoya. Uragu, fai ji nere owonege langa tafa hiyonbona amina mai jugu waha benu.”
Judas no Yesus honggoro fai owonege langa tafa tuwai.

Yesus no beele le gainga, Judas, no disaipel 12 waha nebereha ete, no mai gainga nere fai toomaro oota kesebu bagu nauge bagu yasadu bode no ngate mayane. Nere pris aroro bagu, fai-aita bagu nebere mora bagu, nere huuru niganenga mayane.
Fai no waha Yesus nere owonege langa tafa tuwona waha, no naani ete bona benou lenigai, “Ji fai ete uumba tuwoni boni. Fai waha no Yesus. Tere no yaasu tuwagu.”
Onodu bona, Judas no tigini Yesus bagu goidu bona letuwai, “Ooru hilobainga, Isisiwou fai.” Ono bona uumba tuwai.
Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Baabo, dada ne onowau ganga mainaha waha edo, ne fasadu onowau.” Ono wainga fai nere maidu owonege ayadu bode, Yesus danga bagu yaasu tuwane.
Ariya, fai ete no Yesus ngare otoware waha, nomo oota kesebu mutu ufaro uludu tai. Onodu Pris mora bagu nomo haruwe magana warainga, oota kesebu ago kuli saludu kaitainga meboduwai.
Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Ne name oota kesebu nomo haumu langa ege tanahe minona. Fai oruwa oota kesebu langa warade waha, nere oota kesebu inyabamu nigona bona.
Ne ada isini rute, ji edo yame jijei isoki tuwegenga, no ensel baingaro, ami ago 12 feiya nigou, medu ji hoyo hiyage?
Onou wa, ji onou onowei mata wehenga wa, beele Itou nomo buk langa inyina waha tigini ada heigoga. Itou nomo buk lena, dada waha ji langa tigini heigou.”

Saini wahanga la, Yesus no fai waha lenigai, “Tere warawou fai yo uwa, yebu fai yo ete yaasu tuwagu ganga dorofe, oota kesebu bagu dumuga bagu elegedu ji yaasu hiyagu ganga maiyaha? Ji fati oruwa tempel nomo orei huwanya langa yafa boni fai-aita bagu isisiwou nigi-gene. Tere saini waha langa yaasu hiyei nomo edo uwa yo?
Dada oruwa heigai beha profet nere yeregane waha edomu-wai.” Ono wainga disaipel oruwanga Yesus awa tudu bode heige harawane.
Nere Yesus kot la tafa tuwane.
Fai nere Yesus yaasudu bode, haudu pris anyakaro Kaiafas nomo mata langa manane. Nere nuuni beele isou fai bagu, nere mora bagu, koto wane yafa gane.
Pita no Yesus oojo tudu goyai, ariya no menanga onou baae langa otowai. No pris anyakaro nomo mata orei huwanya langa goidu bona, polis bagu yafane. No taate dada Yesus langa heigonga urei nomo bona.

Nere pris aroro bagu kaunsel oruwanga bagu, nere fai ila yaure niganenga maidu onowou ila, Yesus onowai waha, yaawa wou beele langa malalamudu lewane. No nyabuluwou ete tafai wonga, nere edo dukote wogunga umonbona, waha bode jala kurunga wane.

Ono ganenga, fai baingaro maidu bode yaawawou beele no gogala langa tafane. Ono wane wa, nere nyabuluwou ete no edo langa dukote wogunga umonbona waha te malalamudu lewegu uwa. Onou wa iinga fai nga nononga mayare
onodu leware, “Fai beha no lewai, ‘Ji edo tempel koresedu boni, fati eeinga la ege tawon boni.’ ”
Ono warenga, pris anyakaro no jaidu bona Yesus isoki tuwai, “Adadu, beele beha ne langa waride? Ne beele ete ege ada gidu lewau yo?”

Ono wainga, Yesus no beele ete lewei uwa. Ono wainga pris anyakaro no letuwai, “Ji Itou ago auma bagu unyi langa ne isoki hinini, elebe ne ngalenga tigini ouwela iwau. Ne fai beha Itou no nomo fai-aita bagu gidu hanigei nomo hangada hinai yo? Ne Itou Nomo Idau yo, uwa?”

Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Ne amina lenaha onounga. Onou wa, ji tere letigini, iinga gonga tere Fai Nomo Idau no Itou danga anyakaro bagu owo hilou langa yafa gonga uragu ganga. Onodu bona, no ha laluwa nomo agau ouwe langa yafa gonga monbona.”

Ono wainga, pris anyakaro no beele waha bona horotodu, nomo kolos koraidu kaite bona lewai, “No Itou memesi beele letuna. Ere ege fai ila, fai beha nomo onowou malalamuwei nomo ada yaure nigoboya. Uwa. Gai iingabe Itou memesi tuwaha.
Tere, ere adadu ono tuwei nomo isiya?” Ono wainga nere ege gidu lewane, “No nyabuluwou bagu no edo umonbona.”
Onodu nere Yesus hogo langa, bisinga tubode gula tuwane. Ono bode nere ila ulagu bare bode
letuwane, “Ne fai Itou hangada hinai, elebe ne profet beele lewau. Faiwei ne narina?”
Pita no lewai, ji Yesus boni ada isini.
Pita no malala langa yafa gainga, mata nomo orei huwanya la. Haruwe aita ete golodu maidu bona letuwai, “Ne fere Yesus Galiliha gaara yafere.”
Ono wainga, Pita no unyi kakiri bona fai oruwanga agenege langa uwa iwai, “Ne beele leni beha ji alai uwa.”
Onodu iinga no mata ete orei arasai la otona walanga goyai, Ono gainga haruwe aita ete no uredu bona, fai-aita bagu jugu langa yafane waha benou lenigai, “Fai beha no Yesus Nasaretha bagu yafagai.”
Ono wainga Pita no ege benou lewai, “Ngalenga ouwe langa, ji fai waha boni ada isini.”
Iinga menanga onou, nere fai jugu langa oto wane waha, maidu bode Pita letuwane, “Ngalenga tigini, ne nebereha ete. Name bolote ne malalamu hinaha.”

Ono wanenga Pita no beele danga bagu benou lewai, “Ngalenga tigini ouwe la, ji fai waha boni ada isini. Ji ngalenga lewei uwa wonga, Itou no edo inyabamu hiyonbona.” No leboro gainga, fasayadu onou teewe warai.
Ono wainga, Pita no beele Yesus letuwai waha bona ege ninau isai, “Saini teewe waregu uwa la, ne le eei wau ganga, ne ji boni ada isini wou.” Onodu Pita no malala heigedu bona inyangaaro merenga wai.
